mara: Heads up — I'm doing a small rewrite of the hello quickstart auth flow to support private/VPC deployments and OIDC auth. Need quick PR reviews + a tiny CI tweak. Main changes: replace inline API_KEY example with REDWOOD_AUTH_PROVIDER=oidc, add local dev proxy instructions, and update docker-compose.

alex: SG. Can you paste the exact env var changes here so I can review? Will this break the starter app for existing self-serve users?

mara: Short snippet — keeping old API_KEY example in an appendix for now.

```
# old (still supported in appendix)
REDWOOD_API_KEY=your_api_key_here

# new (recommended for private/VPC/OIDC)
REDWOOD_AUTH_PROVIDER=oidc
OIDC_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
REDWOOD_OIDC_ISSUER=https://idp.example.com
```

mara: Local dev note: we add a tiny auth proxy docker container that exchanges OIDC code for a session token — included in sample compose.

sam: OK — I'll take docker-compose + CI. Quick checklist for me: 1) swap compose service envs, 2) add a smoke test in docs CI that runs the local proxy + quickstart app, 3) ensure tests use test vault secrets not plaintext.

mara: I'll open the docs PR now and add a migration checklist section with explicit steps: "how to move from API_KEY to OIDC for Dedicated/Private" and an appendix with backwards-compat snippet. Also will add a short note about KMS/HSM for client secret storage.

docs-bot: PR opened by mara: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4822 — quickstart: auth migration + compose + migration checklist

alex: Skimmed PR, left two nits: wording around "dev proxy" and a link to the Private Deploy guide (should point to /private-deploy/auth). Also can we add a short sentence about token rotation?

sam: I can update CI to use the prow secret helper. Will also add a smoke test script: `scripts/ci/quickstart_auth_smoke.sh` to run in the docs job. @mara can you add instructions to run smoke script locally?

mara: Yep — will add local run instructions and a one-liner to seed test secrets: `./scripts/dev/seed_test_secrets.sh --provider=oidc`

alex: Fine with merge after nits fixed. If we keep the appendix for 14 days it's easy rollback.

mara: :thumbsup: I'll address comments now. Targeting merge tomorrow 10:00 PT unless anyone objects.

sam: No objections. I'll queue the CI changes once PR lands.

alex: No objections from me either. Thanks for doing this — should make private onboarding smoother.
